basic_details.short_information: Acharya N G Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) is recruiting candidates for 2 Teaching Associate posts on a purely temporary and contractual basis. Eligible applicants with a Ph.D, Master's Degree or Bachelor's Degree in the relevant subject can attend the walk-in interview on 23 October 2026 at Agricultural College, Bapatla. Candidates must register their names before 9:30 AM on the walk-in date with a filled-in application, bringing all original certificates and one set of photo copies of all certificates, publications and other relevant documents. important_instructions: The individual is engaged purely on temporary and contractual basis for a period not exceeding 11 months and will be terminated automatically after completion of 11 months or filling of regular staff by University, whichever is earlier. The incumbent shall not have any claim (or) shall have any right to claim for any regular appointment in University / any government organization. The incumbent shall not have any claim (or) shall have any right for further continuation of contractual service. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification of the candidature at the time of selection (or) termination even during the contractual engagement period. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason thereof. The engaged persons may also leave the contractual service on their own by giving one-month notice, otherwise to be paid one-month salary before leaving. No T.A. & D.A. will be given to the candidates appearing for interview. The decision of the selection committee for the above post will be final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Detailed essential qualifications for the Teaching Associate post include any of the following criteria: Ph.D. in the relevant subject Master's degree in relevant subject Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point average Experience for at least 3 years of respective teaching/research experience as evidenced from Fellowship / Associate ship / Training / Other engagements Published One research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/NAAS rated >=4.0 Journals Candidates having Post-graduate degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have NET qualification

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 40 years for Men and 45 years for Women .

content_sections.heading: Tenure and Terms
content_sections.text: The position of Teaching Associate is purely temporary and contractual on a contractual basis, not exceeding for a period of 11 months. The tenure is 11 months from date of joining/filling of regular post, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled-in application form All original certificates One set of photo copies of all certificates, publications, and other relevant documents

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must register their names before 9:30 AM on 23.10.2026 at Agricultural College, Bapatla. The selection process involves a walk-in interview. Selected candidates will be required to undergo medical examination at their own expenses as per the rules for ensuring their physical fitness before appointment.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The individual is engaged purely on temporary and contractual basis for a period not exceeding 11 months and will be terminated automatically after completion of 11 months or filling of regular staff by University, whichever is earlier. The incumbent shall not have any claim (or) shall have any right to claim for any regular appointment in University / any government organization. The incumbent shall not have any claim (or) shall have any right for further continuation of contractual service. Concealing of facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification of the candidature at the time of selection (or) termination even during the contractual engagement period. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason thereof. The engaged persons may also leave the contractual service on their own by giving one-month notice, otherwise to be paid one-month salary before leaving. No T.A. & D.A. will be given to the candidates appearing for interview. The decision of the selection committee for the above post will be final and binding in all respects.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 23.10.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must register their names before 9:30 AM on the interview date.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Agricultural College, Bapatla.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for the Teaching Associate post in the Department of Agronomy.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D., Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree of 4/5 years in the relevant subject with required experience, publications, or NET qualifications as specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for Men and 45 years for Women.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly remuneration offered?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 61,000/- + HRA per month for Master's Degree holders and Rs. 67,000/- + HRA per month for Ph.D Degree holders.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a filled-in application, all original certificates, and one set of photo copies of all certificates, publications, and other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is the position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary and contractual, for a period not exceeding 11 months or until regular staff is filled, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Are allowances paid on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA will be given as per the existing State Government rates applicable in various places/locations and subjected to change from time to time as per Government orders.
